LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard entry representing a player's clicker progress.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player owning this score entry.

displayName.description: Sanitized player display name (1..40 chars, no PII such as email).

clicks.description: Total click count achieved by the player (>= 0).

lifetimePoints.description: Total lifetime points earned across the player's career (>= 0).

reactorCode.description: Short reactor tier code such as Mk.I through Mk.V.

hasVipPass.description: Whether the player holds the VIP Omega badge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard score was last synchronized.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard scores keyed by authenticated Firebase user UID. Readable by signed-in players; writable only by the owner UID.
